messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: triggered -> INF-GW-eu-west1-5xx-rate (5m avg > 3%) :rotating_light: https://pagerduty.example/INC-48291
sara (oncall): acked. i'm coming in — looking now. any customer reports?
michael: seeing a big 503 spike on inference-gateway-eu-west1 behind the LB. tails show connection reset / upstream read timeout. sample from gateway logs:
```
2026-03-15T03:14:21Z inf-gw[req] 503 upstream read timeout for /v1/generate model=redwood-7b
2026-03-15T03:14:22Z inf-gw[req] 502 connection reset by peer
```
raj: also getting many grpc errors from the worker pool: "rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing" — looks like backend workers failing to accept connections.
sara (oncall): any deploys or config changes in eu-west1 in last 30m? katie?
katie: no deploys on inference stack. infra autoscaler did a small downscale ~25m ago for spot reclamation, might be related. checking HPA and node counts now.
ops-bot: HPA (inf-gw) current replicas=8 desired=8, nodepool-eu-west autoscaler reported scale-down events at 02:52 UTC for nodes: node-72,node-73
michael: sending small grep across worker logs for OOM / sidecar restarts...

michael: found pattern — redis connection floods + a few worker pods in CrashLoopBackOff around 03:12. Looks like KV-cache warmup blast after autoscale.
sara (oncall): ok immediate mitigation: 1) disable inf-gw prefix routing to warmup-heavy customers 2) increase replica count to 16 3) restart crashed workers on-canary first
sara (oncall): @deploy-bot can you scale inf-gw deployment to 16 replicas in eu-west1? include rollout pause
deploy-bot: running: kubectl -n prod scale deploy inf-gateway --replicas=16 --context=eu-west1
deploy-bot: scale acknowledged, rollout in progress. watch: https://k8s-console/namespace/prod/deploy/inf-gateway
katie: bumping nodepool min from 3->5 in eu-west1 now (request sent to cloud autoscaler), ETA ~4m
raj: restarting the 3 worker pods in crashloop: kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy inf-worker; rolling restart started
michael: also temporarily enabling fallback-model routing for legacy models to reduce KV cache pressure: set routing policy -> fallback_variants: [cpu-small-quant] via console
sara (oncall): good. I'm going to hit the runbook: https://wiki.redwood/5xx-inference-runbook — tracking customer impact there.

sara (oncall): quick customer check: dashboard shows 8% of requests failing for a subset of customers (prefix heavy). most other customers unaffected.
katie: opening a CS ticket to notify customers with elevated error rates. tag: customer-impact-high
ops-bot: alert suppression enabled for INF-GW-eu-west1 for 10m to avoid alert storm
michael: logs after restarts: 503s dropping but still some 502 remnants. sample:
```
2026-03-15T03:18:05Z inf-gw[req] 502 upstream reset for /v1/chat
2026-03-15T03:18:10Z inf-gw[req] 200 proxied for /v1/generate
```
sara (oncall): good trend. estimate 60% mitigation after scale + restarts. continuing to watch for 15m.

raj: note — worker sidecars have an older libssl that mis-handles many short-lived connections under load. created CHORE-314 to upgrade image, but not safe to do right now.
sara (oncall): okay include that as postmortem action item. primary fix = increase steady capacity + tune cache warming.

katie: i'm taking a 30m handoff in ~15m. @sara will you summarize critical points for handoff?
katie: also prepping fallback traffic rule to route 10% traffic to south-region if we see another spike.
sara (oncall): handoff summary: incident started 03:14 UTC, cause = likely autoscale down + cache warmup causing worker connection churn. immediate mitigations applied: scaled inf-gw ->16, restarted crashed workers, increased nodepool min ->5, enabled fallback routing and suppressed noisy alerts. customer impact: ~8% requests failing for warmup-heavy prefixes, CS notified. oncall-> katie (primary) for next 30m, escalate to raj/infra if reappearance.

katie: acked handoff. will monitor metrics and coordinate with infra if we see >3% again. :eyes:

michael: creating a short query for long-tail 5xx by prefix and posting to #monitoring — link: https://grafana/redwood/d/inf-gw-5xx

sara (oncall): thanks team. i'll update the incident summary and add RCA notes. tagging postmortem: yes. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident ticket INC-48291 status=mitigated monitored_until=2026-03-15T04:00:00Z
katie: will keep watch; please DM if anything else spikes. handing off presence to @katie now. :hand:
